title: Ordinary unbounded total derived integral pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $B_Z=\varprojlim_{n\geq0}(R/t^{n+1})_Z$ for $Z=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the canonical ordinary additive module pullback $f_B^*: \operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B_X)$, with its completed coefficient map and sheafified Kan-extension adjunction, of [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction]. Write $Q_Z:K(\operatorname{Mod}(B_Z))\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_Z))$ for localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $F=Q_X\circ K(f_B^*)$. Its total left derived functor exists. Define the ordinary unbounded derived pullback $Lf_B^*:D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y))\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$ to be the total left derived functor of $F$ along $Q_Y$, with its universal counit $Lf_B^*\circ Q_Y\to F$. This is the right Kan extension of $F$ along $Q_Y$, determined up to the unique isomorphism compatible with that counit. No derived completion is applied.

proof.text: Present the completed-ring module inverse image by proEtaleAlgebraicInverseImage_exists. The pro-etale set inverse image preserves finite limits by toposFunctorialityInverseImage. Compose the canonical module inverse-image adjunction with the explicit same-site tensor/restriction adjunction for the adjunct completed coefficient map. The unit/counit identity for the coefficient adjunction identifies its right adjoint with completed-coefficient module pushforward. The unique left-adjoint comparison therefore identifies this tensor functor with the specified ordinaryIntegralModulePull.

proof.text: Apply ringedTopoiDerivedPullbackIndependent to the algebraic inverse-image presentation and the explicit tensor functor. It supplies a homotopy-category total left derived functor with counit invertible on flat-term K-flat complexes. Transport existence across the additive left-adjoint comparison to prove ordinaryIntegralPull_hasLeftDerived. The unique counit-normalized derived comparison transports invertibility to ordinaryIntegralPullCounit; the remaining factors defining ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit are localization isomorphisms. Thus ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit_isIso follows for every good representative.
